_comment: MEASURED, NOT GUESSED (DIVE-8258, dev2, 2026-11-12). Before this file a connected Instagram read UNKNOWN on every box, and on a partner box nobody could ever turn it green (box bug 902). Logged OUT, /accounts/edit/ is answered by the SERVER with a 302 to /accounts/login/?next=… — the cookie decides it, not JavaScript. That login page carries Meta's current-user record with account 0 in its server-sent bytes (curl: 2 matches; the rendered page in a real Chrome at 1.5 s and at 8 s: 1 match), and its rendered form has a password field (<input type="password" name="pass">, 1 match at 1.5 s and at 8 s). So the marker does not wait for the app to draw: a logged-out probe matches even on the bare shell.

probe._comment: SIGNED-IN HALF MEASURED (DIVE-8477, 2026-11-14), on a real Instagram account NOT linked to Facebook (partner client, browser 1.87.0): the probe's own cold --dump-dom of /accounts/edit/ at his profile gave a 1.37 MB page, no redirect, 0 login_form, 0 password inputs, and Meta's current-user record with ACCOUNT_ID "0" (x2) and a non-zero NON_FACEBOOK_USER_ID (x2) in the same record. ACCOUNT_ID is the FACEBOOK account id, "0" for every Instagram account not linked to Facebook; the Instagram id is NON_FACEBOOK_USER_ID. So 1.87.0's signed-out marker (record with ACCOUNT_ID 0) read that signed-in page as expired and Done reopened the sign-in. Signed out is now the record with ACCOUNT_ID 0 AND NON_FACEBOOK_USER_ID 0 (curl of the logged-out page, 2026-11-14: 2 matches, the record carries both ids as 0), or the login form's own id; signed in is a non-zero ACCOUNT_ID in the record or a non-zero NON_FACEBOOK_USER_ID (his page: 2; logged out: 0). UNMEASURED HALF: a signed-in account LINKED to Facebook (non-zero ACCOUNT_ID) was not observed. DIVE-8457 (box reports 942/974): never a bare password field as the signed-out reading. A page that shows neither reads UNKNOWN and Done hands the site over as 'connected, not confirmed' (1.86.0).
